product_version: 2.20 (latest logical version, June 2026; open-source line ships weekly production-ready edge releases, latest edge-26.6.x)
version_sensitive_claims: Current logical version is Linkerd 2.20 (announced 2026-06-23); 2.x is the only supported line, 1.x deprecated

Since Feb 2024 the Linkerd OSS project no longer publishes stable release artifacts; the vendor community (Buoyant Enterprise for Linkerd, commercial) provides stable builds. Open source stays Apache 2.0 as weekly, production-ready edge releases — stable is NOT necessarily paid and edge is NOT 'unstable'

Linkerd supports non-Kubernetes workloads via mesh expansion (ExternalWorkload CRD, workload.linkerd.io/v1beta1) since ~2.15 — it is not Kubernetes-only, though multi-platform is younger/less mature than Consul/Istio
Modern traffic split uses Gateway API HTTPRoute weighted backendRefs (full support since 2.14); SMI TrafficSplit was moved out of core into the linkerd-smi extension in 2.12 and is legacy
Modern retries/timeouts use Gateway API annotations retry.linkerd.io/* and timeout.linkerd.io/* on HTTPRoute/GRPCRoute (since 2.16); ServiceProfile is the classic/legacy per-route mechanism

Distributed tracing is configured via OpenTelemetry (proxies emit OTLP spans to an OTel collector); the linkerd-jaeger bundle still exists but OpenTelemetry is the recommended path and tracing is not part of Viz
Grafana was removed from the Viz bundle in 2.12 due to its AGPL license
Performance benchmark numbers (p99 ~1-2 ms vs ~5-10 ms, sidecar ~30 MB vs ~50-100 MB) are sidecar-mode, vendor/CNCF-sourced, version- and load-dependent; Istio Ambient (sidecar-less) narrows the gap
